statement: The blueberry variety 'DrisBlueSeventeen', trade name Carlotta, received Canadian plant breeders' rights certificate 7097 on 3 May 2024 under application 19-9740, applicant Driscoll's, Inc. of Watsonville, California. Its origin is given as '136D 2' crossed with '8B 4' in 2004 in Santa Cruz County, California, selected in 2006.
